plainTranslation: Their Moon in your 12th house: deep unconscious emotional resonance - they feel familiar in a way you can't explain, like old recognition. Failure mode: projecting your unmet needs onto them, or a hidden emotional dynamic running things. Make the feelings conscious; don't run the relationship from your blind spot.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Imported from approved project marquee synastry house overlay material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
